Collection.description: A collection as returned by the API; built straight from `store.CollectionRow`.
Collection.title: Collection

ItemProperties.description:
Core fields plus whatever the header said (`proj:shape`, `raster:bands`, `pc:count`,
`mesh:triangles`, ...), which is why other keys are allowed.
ItemProperties.title: ItemProperties

NextLink.description:
STAC's link to the next page of a POST search: repeat the request with `body` merged
into it.
NextLink.title: NextLink

Reason.description: Why the pipeline rejected a version. Quarantine's reason is the scanner's signature.
Reason.title: Reason

SearchIn.description:
Every filter given must hold for every result (SRCH-1); a list filter that is empty
matches nothing.
SearchIn.title: SearchIn

Upload.description: An upload as returned by the API; built straight from `store.UploadRow`.
Upload.title: Upload

UploadPage.description: The caller's own uploads, newest first.
UploadPage.title: UploadPage

UploadSession.description: An upload plus the signed URL its bytes go to. The URL is shown once and never stored.
UploadSession.title: UploadSession

schema.title: Response List Grants Collections  Collection Id  Grants Get

get.description: Public, non-secret settings for the SPA, so one web build runs against any IdP or cloud.

post.description:
One page of readable items matching every filter, newest first. Follow the `next` link,
merging its body into this request, for the following page.

get.description:
One page of the caller's own uploads in collections they can still read, newest first.
Pass `next` back as `token` for the following page.

post.description: A new signed URL for an upload still in progress, for transfers that outlast one.
